::: {#def-structural-induction}
#### Structural induction

**Structural induction** [@wikipedia_structural_induction] is a way to prove that every element of a recursively defined set (@def-recursive-set)
has a property $P$, in two steps:

1. **Base case.**
   Show that every element that the set's base case names has $P$.
2. **Inductive step.**
   Show that whenever the recursive rule builds a new element from elements that have $P$,
   the new element has $P$ too.

:::
